# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="registry inspect hangar project self diff merge run tasks check test prove build dev debug repl notebook import new fmt fix lint explain env cache remote trust image os add remove fetch update init split fold gc clean emit eval budget perf report bench fuzz version help"
flags="--attach --once --observe --gc-trace --structural --out --report --repo --json --quiet --color --version --check --restore-role-files --diff --changed --skipped --stdin-path --small --task --output --locked --lock -p --annotated --force --no-sign --registry --pkg --clang --ar --from --to --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --edition --try-anyway --interpret --trace-tiers --restart --swap --watch --project --pure --freestanding --allow-impure --target --explain-partition --capabilities-json --update-snapshots --coverage --rust --emit-generated -u --release --profile --builder --a11y --scope --filter --shuffle --serial --iterations --time --seed --corpus --lens --facts --annotations --baseline --bootstrap --accept-regression --reason --yes -y --allow-net --deny-net --allow-fs --deny-fs --allow-io --deny-io --allow-db --deny-db --allow-time --deny-time --allow-rand --deny-rand --allow-env --deny-env --allow-exec --deny-exec --allow-log --deny-log --allow-gpu --deny-gpu"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 2 ]]; then
case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
        registry) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "publish yank keygen key vendor" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        inspect) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "live graph query explain-build compiler impact dossier semindex expand unsafe schema codemod audit sbom bind logs search info outdated reserved facts" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        hangar) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "verify repair copy import export dump restore sign rollback generations du" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        project) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "parts" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        self) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "toolchain upgrade doctor completions man devtools lsp" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        os) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "push bridge services config" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        gc) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "report" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        perf) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "run test bench attach view compare export" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        esac
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
